name: ItemTemplateFieldInput
description: Represents the input for creating or updating a template field.

inputFields.name: blob
inputFields.description: The flag indicating whether the field is a blob field.

inputFields.name: defaultValue
inputFields.description: The default value of the template field.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: The description of the template field.

inputFields.name: excludeFromTextSearch
inputFields.description: The flag indicating whether to exclude the content of the field from full text search index.

inputFields.name: helpLink
inputFields.description: The help link of the template field.

inputFields.name: icon
inputFields.description: The icon of the template field.

inputFields.name: ignoreDictionaryTranslations
inputFields.description: The flag indicating whether to ignore dictionary translations.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: The name of the template field.

inputFields.name: sharedLanguageFallbackEnabled
inputFields.description: The flag indicating whether to enable the shared Language Fallback.

inputFields.name: sortOrder
inputFields.description: The sort order of the template field.

inputFields.name: source
inputFields.description: The source of the template field.

inputFields.name: style
inputFields.description: The style of the template field.

inputFields.name: templateFieldId
inputFields.description: The unique ID of the template field. If the ID is empty, a new template field if ID will be created. Otherwise, the template field will be updated.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: The title of the template field.

inputFields.name: tooltip
inputFields.description: The tooltip of the template field.

inputFields.name: type
inputFields.description: The type of the template field.

inputFields.name: validation
inputFields.description: The validation of the template field.

inputFields.name: validationText
inputFields.description: The validation text of the template field.

inputFields.name: versioning
inputFields.description: The versioning of the template field.
